reviews.x: I never write reviews, but this time I had to do it!!!! This product is AMAZING!!!!! I damaged my hair pretty good after bleaching , dying and then again bleaching me hair all in one month. I really thought I would need to chup my hair off, then someone told me about this mask , it's a miracle , my hair feels so soft and it looks so healthy , everybody is noticing it and telling me that my hair look so healthy , definatley worth the money !!!

I am using this in conjunction with the matching shampoo, etc and it is working great.  I had a perm on my hair and it was dramatically damaged enough that I was going to cut it all off.  This has helped so much that it saved my hair.  The condition has drastically improved and I will continue to use it. It is worth the money for me.

I give a zero to this product for following reasons: 1. There is no seal in the product package or the product itself 2. Product package is broken and aged 3. The smell is nowhere close to Oribe, but similar to Pantene 4. This is the 4th Oribe product I purchased, and this is the worst experience I ever had with this brand.  I would give a 0 if I can. I am so disappointed and frustrated with this purchase.

I absolutely adore this product. This is the ONLY hair mask / conditioning treatment that actually works on my hair.  My hair is thin, fine, brittle, and dry -- some of that is genetics, some of it is because I was bleaching my hair and dying it.  This product actually works.  It makes my split ends feel soft and healthy again, and the rest of my hair is soft and manageable as well, and lasts the rest of the day!  Some products feel like the wear off after a while, or doesn't enhance the softnes

I had been searching for a solution to make my hair look like it did 20 years ago. I found Oribe quite by accident when my hair stylist used it during my appointment. I drove back the next day to ask what she had used. I ordered it from Amazon immediately. The Gold Lust shampoo, conditioner and mask are nothing short of amazing. The masque is AMAZING. I noticed a big difference once I tried this product, sometimes I would even use it instead of the conditioner!! My hair felt really dry and tangly so I got this and noticed it made it feel much more manageable. smoother and more moisturized. It's also safe with the brazilian blow out and smells so nice.

I use Cholesterol and another hair treatment and this one is my favorite of the three. My hair feels to soft, very manageable, and stronger and healthier! Love it. It's expensive, so I don't order it all the time. If it was cheaper, I'd buy stock in it!

I use this masque once a week.  It is absolutely amazing!!  It leaves my hair thicker, shiny and super manageable. I spend winter months in the States, and before returning to Canada, I brought several tubes back with me as I can't imagine life with it!

My hair texture was impossible - coloring and age (62) made my hair look frumpy and untidy no matter what I tried.  My hair only looked good the day the stylist took care of it, otherwise I looked unkempt regardless of time spent with the blow dryer and various hair products.  Until today.  I just got my Oribe Gold Lust Transformative Masque, and despite the ridiculous name of the stuff - it worked like a miracle.  Just like all those hair products promise, this stuff actually made my hair soft,

I have a short sassy haircut and am a no shampoo girl; for 2 1/2 years I have used a conditioner to both cleanse and condition my hair in one step.  This Transformative Masque is one of my favorite hair care products.  Leaves my scalp and hair nicely cleansed and luxuriously moisturized, hair is soft and a breeze to style.  More expensive than a "traditional" conditioner, but you'll use less as a little of this luxurious masque goes a long way.

reviews.t: But I am already disappointed after 1st use
reviews.x: So I decided to buy this after reading all the reviewer praising it. But I am already disappointed after 1st use. reason being: no instruction manual in box. so how am I suppose to use it? do we need to shampoo before or after?? apply on wet or dry hair?? no information available. i will update my review once I find out how to use it and if this has any affect on my color damaged dry hair.

When I tell you that I have tried every hair product under the sun, I am kidding you not. Every.single.one-and with much disappointment. This product, however, is an exceptional exception. Well worth the price. My long hair is finally manageable. Instead of frizzy at the end of the day, it is now soft and silky. Do yourself a favor and splurge.

I LOVE this product. I've had white (and I mean white white whiiiite) hair for years and this helps so much with helping damage. I've only this year decided to go back to my natural hair and let it grow out super long and I still love using this product.  It has a very light scent that reminds me of something from childhood but I can't place it.  It leaves Hair feeling SO soft and almost better than before. This conditioner from Oribe is a must have for anyone looking to transform their dull over processed hair and the signature scent of Oribe's products is amazing.

Love this masque. Use it once a week and it has totally transformed my hair. I have Polynesian hair that is very dry and unruly at times.... this masque does wonders! Softens, shines and just makes my hair look so much better

reviews.t: Amazing and well worth the price for smooth and shiny, healthy feeling hair.
reviews.x: This and the Gold Lust Pre-Shampoo Intensive Treatment are amazing. The pre treatment: YOU MUST MASSAGE INTO AN OIL TYPE CONSISTENCY BEFORE APPLYING TO HAIR. Massage in your hand and then run through your ends. I will sleep in it overnight or let sit for about 20 minutes. AMAZING stuff. I have purchased so many products for my dry, curly color treated hair. This is the best. Worth every single penny

I decided to take the plunge and get this based on all the rave reviews. I did notice an improvement with my hair quality but no more than with any other mask or treatment. The price is ridiculous and the bottle is small.
Product  was not properly sealed at all. Scent is nothing like previous products I purchased elsewhere. Not sure if this is the real product.

reviews.t: Too bad I can’t return it
reviews.x: How does this $65 hair mask differ from the 2 for $5 Neutrogena masks I bought at Walgreens? It doesn’t. Too bad I can’t return it. I purchased this because my hair is very dry and damaged due to bleaching it and thought from the reviews that this would help prevent me from having to chop my hair off but I can safely say after 5 uses it has done nothing to help my hair. Why they can get away with charging $65 when regular hair masks cost a fraction of that? Beats me.

I thought using this product would repair my hair. I followed the directions and followed up using the Gold Lust shampoo & conditioner. My hair looks greasy as if it hasn't been washed in a month and is still dry. Not quite sure how this can happen. I do know my product was not counterfeit so I can honestly state my opinion that this is dreadful! I see so many positive reviews and am baffled...

reviews.t: Best conditioner that I've ever used
reviews.x: Although this product is expensive, you only need a little, so the container has a lot more times you can use it than what it looks like.  It smells great, and makes my hair so smooth and silky.  It also helps give my hair more body for styling.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the mask dramatically improves damaged, dry, or brittle hair, making it softer, smoother, and more manageable.
Many customers consider the product expensive but say it is worth the price.
Several reviewers praise the product's scent as divine.
A few reviewers raise concerns about packaging and authenticity, including a broken or aged box, no seal, and a smell unlike Oribe.
One reviewer was disappointed by the lack of usage instructions in the box.
